translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 1 TESALONICENSES
book.title: An c’a’al u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Tesalónica c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: Ebchalabchic, yabats jale’ nan tu thuchanchi tin cuenta c’al an q’uijcha tam ne’ets ca chich an Ajatic.
A lej tso’obitschic abal ne’ets quim baju im bijith q’uichajil an Ajatic tam ca chich tam ti ni jita’ yab in t’ilom. Ne’ets ca chich jun jic’tohual ejtil u che’el i cue’ jun jic’tohual tam acal.

Tam hue’its ne’ets ca chich an Ajatic an inicchic ne’ets quin ulu abal patal c’uajatits jun ejet ani lej alhua’ in huat’al. Ma tamna’its jun jic’tohual ne’ets ca t’ajat q’uibetha. Jant’ini’ i uxum jun jic’tohual in ats’al i c’athpich yajal tin chucul tam ne’ets ca hua’tsin an t’ele’, antsana’ nixe’ xi inicchic jun jic’tohual ne’ets quin ats’a’ lej yajchic. Yab ne’ets quin ejtou lejatits abal ju’ta ta ca t’ajat pit’c’on.

Tata’ ebchalabchic yabats it xe’ets al an yic’uax, ani jaxtam tam quim baju an q’uicha tam ca chich an Ajatic yab ne’ets quit jiq’uey ejtil u jiq’uel an inic tam u che’el jun jic’tohual i cue’ tam acal.
Patal tata’chic a cua’al in tajax a Dios ta ichich ani a t’ajalchic alhua’. Yabats yic’utsith a ichich ani yabats a t’ajal yab alhua’ ejtil am pojcax inic.
Jaxtam yab quit xe’tsinchic huayamathq’ui a ichich ejtil axi yab exlom c’al a Dios. Quit xe’tsin c’al a ichich lej ts’ejcacath ani tsalpath.
An inic u huayal tam acal ani hua’ats ax u uts’al tam acal.

Huahua’ ax i t’ajal alhua’ in tomnal cu xe’tsin lej inic. An soldado in cua’al im pat’al coton tin ichich inictal abal yab ca c’olchin in ichich, ani huahua’ tu soldado c’al a Cristo qui lej bela’ ani qui lej c’anitha’ jaja’ ti ichich abal yab cu c’olchin c’al jahua’ ca chich yab alhua’. An soldado tam tu pejéx paxq’uith in oc’ c’al i tacab oc’ abal yab ca c’olchin in oc’, ani huahua’ qui tsalapnanchi in jec’onthaxtal a Dios abal yab cu c’olchin i tsalap c’al jahua’ yab alhua’.
Pel in culbetal a Dios abal i Ajatic Jesucristo tucu jec’ontha’ ets’ey c’al an hualabtalab ani jaye c’al an yajchictalab axi ne’ets ca abchin talbel an inicchic axi yab im belal.

A Jesucristo tu taletnanchamalits an yajchictalab c’al huahua’ ti cuenta abal cu junax c’uajiy c’al jaja’. Max cu xe’tsine ejat teje’ tsabal ani max cu tsemets, bel ne’ets cu c’uajiy ets’ey ejat c’al jaja’ ti eb.

Ca t’iloxnanchiyechic an ebchalabchic patal axe’ xi cau ax nan tu thuchanchal, ani antsana’ quit ejthanchíxin ani quit tsaplinchíxin a ichich jun c’al xi jun. Antsana’ a t’ajamalits ani antsana’ ta ca t’ajaye.
I ts’alabchixtalab
Ebchalabchic, tu lubath uchal ca c’ac’na’ jaja’chic ax ti oc’nanchal ani ti ts’alabchal tin cuenta c’al in t’ojlabil an Ajatic.
Ca lej t’ajchi ti cuenta in ey ani ca lej c’anitha’ cum in t’ojonchal an Ajatic. Quit c’uajiychic jun ejet.
Ebchalabchic, ca c’uiya’ axi yab in le’ ti t’ojnal. Ca lubachmethanchi in ichich jitats yab canat ani ca tolmiy jita’ yab in ejtohual ca tsapne. Ca c’aya’na’ patal an inicchic.
Max jita’ ti pojcax t’ajchal, yab ca huichbanchi. Ets’ey ca luba’ ca t’ajchi alhua’ tim patal an inicchic.
Ets’ey culbel a ichich ca ne’tha’.
Ni jayq’ui’ yab ca palc’anchi tit ol.
Jahuaquitsq’ui ca huat’a’ ca bina’ i c’ac’namal yan c’al a Dios, cum pel in culbetal a Dios antsana’ quim bina’ i c’ac’namal yan jitats ts’at’bathits c’al a Cristo Jesús.
Yab ca teptha’ in tajax an Espíritu Santo ta ichich.
Yab ca pojcanchi in cahuintal an caulomechic ax u pithnal i cau c’al a Dios.
Ca tala’ lecchi an cau max alhua’, ani max alhua’its ca t’ayat pena’ ta ichich.
Ca tala’ jila’ patal jahua’ yab alhua’.

U lej le’ abal a Dios ti jum putat t’oquetha’chic. Ti lubach beletnanchi a ichich ani a ejattal ani a inictal abal tam ca chich i Ajatic Jesucristo yab quit elchin jant’o ta quit jolbiyat. Jats a Dios ax ti jun ejetbethanchal a ichich.
In ey jaja’ lej pututh, ani antsana’ ne’ets ti t’ajchichic cum ti tacuyamalits tin c’al jaja’.
An tsapnethomtalab
Ebchalabchic, tucu conchinchi i alhua’talab c’al a Dios.
Tiquin tsapnethanchi patal an ebchalabchic tihua’ c’al i t’ocat c’anithomtalab.
C’al im bij an Ajatic nan tu lej uchalchic ca ajinchi axe’ xi u patal an ebchalabchic c’al a Cristo.
U lej le’ abal ti lubach co’onchi a ichich i Ajatic Jesucristo c’al in alhua’ inictal. Amén.
